WHERE CAST(m.tenant_id AS BINARY)=#{tenant} AND CAST(c.tenant_id AS BINARY)=#{tenant} AND CAST(c.user_id AS BINARY)=#{user} AND CAST(c.id AS BINARY)=#{session} AND CAST(m.id AS BINARY)=s.source_object_ref AND m.role IN ('user','USER') AND CAST(SHA2(CAST(m.content_markdownm.content AS BINARY),256) AS BINARY)=s.source_version)
